goal: Create a project-specific comet-classic five-phase workflow Skill for building the daily speaking analysis tool, starting from the design Node.

workflow.name: comet-classic
workflow.goal: Guide the agent through open/design/build/verify/archive to build the speaking analysis tool.

open.responsibility: Create a Classic change and confirm the problem statement and scope from the user's request.

design.responsibility: Produce the architecture and implementation plan for the speaking analysis tool, using the clarified requirements from the Native brief as seed input.

requiredSkillCalls.reason: Generate architecture diagrams for the speaking analysis pipeline.

plan.responsibility: Break design into concrete implementation tasks and acceptance criteria.

execute.responsibility: Implement the code according to design and plan.

review.responsibility: Review implementation against design and acceptance criteria.

verify.responsibility: Run validation and tests to prove the implementation works.

archive.responsibility: Finalize the change and commit/merge if appropriate.
